3	description: Shared data models for Kotlin Multiplatform using kotlinx.serialization. Cross-platform domain models with validation and serialization.
4	---
5	
6	# Shared Models for KMP
7	
8	Design and implement data models that work across all platforms in `shared/commonMain`.
9	
10	## Core Dependencies
11	
12	```kotlin
13	// build.gradle.kts (shared module)
14	sourceSets {
15	    val commonMain by getting {
16	        dependencies {
17	            implementation("org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-serialization-json:1.6.0")
18	            implementation("org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-datetime:0.6.1") // kotlinx-datetime has no 1.x release; 0.6.x is the current stable line
19	        }
20	    }
21	}
22	```
23	
24	Enable serialization plugin:
25	```kotlin
26	plugins {
27	    kotlin("multiplatform")
28	    kotlin("plugin.serialization") version "2.0.21" // aligned with room-patterns' Kotlin/KSP toolchain version
29	}
30	```
31	
32	## Domain Models
33	
34	### 1. Immutable Data Classes
35	
36	```kotlin
37	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/User.kt
38	@Serializable
39	data class User(
40	    val id: String,
41	    val name: String,
42	    val email: String,
43	    val avatarUrl: String?,
44	    val createdAt: Instant,
45	    val lastActiveAt: Instant?
46	)
47	```
48	
49	### 2. Sealed Hierarchies
50	
51	```kotlin
52	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/UiState.kt
53	@Serializable
54	sealed class UiState<out T> {
55	    @Serializable
56	    data object Loading : UiState<Nothing>()
57	
58	    @Serializable
59	    data class Success<T>(val data: T) : UiState<T>()
60	
61	    @Serializable
62	    data class Error(val message: String, val code: String? = null) : UiState<Nothing>()
63	}
64	
65	// Usage with type parameter
66	@Serializable
67	sealed class HomeState {
68	    @Serializable
69	    data object Loading : HomeState()
70	
71	    @Serializable
72	    data class Loaded(val user: User, val items: List<Item>) : HomeState()
73	
74	    @Serializable
75	    data class Error(val message: String) : HomeState()
76	}
77	```
78	
79	### 3. DomainOutcome Wrapper
80	
81	```kotlin
82	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/DomainOutcome.kt
83	// Named DomainOutcome, not Result, so it doesn't shadow kotlin.Result.
84	@Serializable
85	sealed class DomainOutcome<out T> {
86	    @Serializable
87	    data class Success<T>(val data: T) : DomainOutcome<T>()
88	
89	    @Serializable
90	    data class Error(val code: String, val message: String) : DomainOutcome<Nothing>()
91	}
92	
93	// Helper to convert to Kotlin's stdlib Result
94	fun <T> DomainOutcome<T>.toKotlinResult(): kotlin.Result<T> = when (this) {
95	    is DomainOutcome.Success -> kotlin.Result.success(data)
96	    is DomainOutcome.Error -> kotlin.Result.failure(RuntimeException("$code: $message"))
97	}
98	```
99	
100	### 4. Paginated Response
101	
102	```kotlin
103	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/Pagination.kt
104	@Serializable
105	data class PaginatedResponse<T>(
106	    val items: List<T>,
107	    val page: Int,
108	    val pageSize: Int,
109	    val totalPages: Int,
110	    val totalItems: Long
111	) {
112	    val hasMorePages: Boolean get() = page < totalPages
113	    val nextPage: Int? get() = if (hasMorePages) page + 1 else null
114	}
115	
116	// For cursor-based pagination
117	@Serializable
118	data class CursorResponse<T>(
119	    val items: List<T>,
120	    val nextCursor: String?,
121	    val hasMore: Boolean
122	)
123	```

126	
127	```kotlin
128	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/auth/AuthRequests.kt
129	@Serializable

131	    val email: String,

154	)

158	
159	### Inline Validation
160	
161	```kotlin
162	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/Validation.kt
163	@Serializable
164	data class Email(val value: String) {
165	    init {
166	        require(value.contains("@")) { "Invalid email format" }
167	        require(value.length > 5) { "Email too short" }
168	    }
169	
170	    companion object {
171	        fun of(value: String?): Email? {
172	            return if (!value.isNullOrBlank()) Email(value) else null
173	        }
174	    }
175	}
176	
177	@Serializable
178	data class PhoneNumber(val value: String) {
179	    init {
180	        require(value.matches(Regex("^\\+?[1-9]\\d{1,14}$"))) {
181	            "Invalid phone number format"
182	        }
183	    }
184	}
185	```

188	
189	```kotlin
190	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/ValidationError.kt
191	@Serializable
192	data class ValidationError(
193	    val field: String,
194	    val message: String
195	)
196	
197	@Serializable
198	data class ValidationResult(
199	    val isValid: Boolean,
200	    val errors: List<ValidationError> = emptyList()
201	) {
202	    companion object {
203	        fun success() = ValidationResult(isValid = true)
204	        fun failure(errors: List<ValidationError>) = ValidationResult(
205	            isValid = false,
206	            errors = errors
207	        )
208	    }
209	}
210	
211	// Usage in models
212	@Serializable
213	data class CreateUserRequest(
214	    val name: String,
215	    val email: String,
216	    val age: Int?
217	) {
218	    fun validate(): ValidationResult {
219	        val errors = buildList {
220	            if (name.isBlank()) {

222	            }
223	            if (email.isBlank() || !email.contains("@")) {
224	                add(ValidationError("email", "Invalid email"))
225	            }
226	            if (age != null && age < 0) {
227	                add(ValidationError("age", "Age cannot be negative"))
228	            }
229	        }
230	        return if (errors.isEmpty()) ValidationResult.success()
231	        else ValidationResult.failure(errors)
232	    }
233	}

270	// commonMain/kotlin/com/example/shared/model/InstantSerializer.kt
271	object InstantSerializer : KSerializer<Instant> {
272	    override val descriptor: SerialDescriptor =
273	        PrimitiveSerialDescriptor("Instant", PrimitiveKind.LONG)
274	
275	    override fun serialize(encoder: Encoder, value: Instant) {
276	        encoder.encodeLong(value.toEpochMilliseconds())

226	        if (connectivityMonitor.isConnected.first()) {

236	                pendingOpsDao.delete(op)
